text:
[RFCS.6a.3] `FactEmit` is **compare** class ([RFCS.3.4]). A replayer
re-derives it by firing the same rule and byte-compares it against the
record ([LFST.9.3]); it **must not** deliver it to the engine as an
input.

A re-derived fact's reference slot carries the `fact_id` of the fact it refers
to, as a live engine writes it ([RFCS.6.3]), and a replayer **must** compare it
as written. `fact_id` is part of every compared body, so a replay that passes
reproduces the recording's `fact_id`s, and the slot is then the recorded
handle. A slot that differs from the record is a divergence like any other.

This is what `[LFST.9.2]` requires of an engine-internal event, and what
`[RARC.5.8.11]` requires of a `LogicalAssert`. A replayer that delivered it
would feed the engine its own output back as input, so the determinism check
could not cover facts at all.
